verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms https://docs.rev.ai/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with a structured table of contents linking to .md pages. Individual docs pages are served as markdown (e.g. get-started.md, features.md), and the docs portal offers an MCP server install for Cursor, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. The root .md path 404s, but that is minor. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming the llms.txt/markdown docs, and evidence of an llms-full.txt or full-corpus export.
